title: Document advanced recipe search and filter behavior
description: Update architecture documentation to describe the broadened Recipes search predicate, catalog-derived filter inputs, per-scene filter state, and filtered empty-state behavior.
acceptance_criteria: `docs/architecture.md` explains that Recipes search now matches display name, title, normalized tags, and ingredient names.
The documentation notes that filter options come from catalog-derived metadata values and that filter state is per scene via `@SceneStorage`, not persisted across launches.
Behavioral notes include the under-time exclusion rule for untimed recipes and the clear-filters empty-state affordance.
